caption: The image is a pencil drawing on paper, visually rendered in shades of gray and off-white, depicting three technical views of a single iron object. The main object is an iron trivet with an openwork design, composed of intersecting curves and scrollwork within a roughly triangular or shield-like outline. The upper part of the drawing presents a top view of the trivet, displaying its symmetrical, ornate pattern with two parallel bars at the center, and a handle formed with two loops at one end. Directly beneath the top view is a side (profile) view illustrating the thickness of the iron and the presence of three short, downward legs for support. To the right of the profile view is a small, horizontal measurement scale labeled with incremental units. Below these, occupying the lower part of the page, is a shaded, three-dimensional perspective view of the trivet, angled to display both the curvilinear detail on the surface and the three support legs beneath, all rendered in a darker shade to suggest depth and volume. The background is a plain, cream-colored surface, and the object is the sole subject, with no other items present in the drawing.
title: Trivet
